**In one line**: OpenAI President Greg Brockman has reportedly dropped a plan to give $25 million to a pro-AI super PAC after facing backlash.

### Key points
- Greg Brockman, OpenAI's president, has reportedly abandoned a plan to contribute **$25 million** to a pro-AI super PAC.
- The reversal is attributed to **backlash** that followed the plan becoming public.
- Super PACs channel money into US elections and policy fights; the episode reads as a signal in the growing contest over how AI should be regulated. (per Forbes)

### Why it matters
It captures both the push by AI-industry leaders to shape the regulatory landscape through political money and the swift pushback such moves can draw. The limits of how far the industry can press its influence on AI policy are being tested in public.
